ns2:section.sectionText: This course will introduce students to techniques used in monitoring and research for mammal ecology and conservation. We will focus on survey methods including sampling, capturing, and marking mammals. This course meets through Oct. 15. In addition, please hold Oct. 22 as a class makeup date in case of inclement weather during the regular sessions. Classes will meet Saturdays 9am-1pm with three exceptions: two Saturday afternoon meetings to set traps, two Sunday mornings to check traps, and one evening to do surveys for bats. Classes will primarily meet at the Arboretum within walking distance of campus. If you are interested in taking the course and do not meet the restrictions, or if the course is filled, you can add yourself to the waiting list by completing the form at http://go.illinois.edu/NRESwaitinglist.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
